svg.text: Two of each of the five. Hold as many as you like, present up to three, spend at most one.

g.text: Overtake
If your opponent holds the centre
square, take that stone off the
board and back into their hand.
A Mountain is not safe from it.
Spend at the end of your turn — moved second only, one a game.
Overtake
If your opponent holds the centre
square, take that stone off the
board and back into their hand.
A Mountain is not safe from it.
Spend at the end of your turn — moved second only, one a game.
Relocate
Move one of your own stones to any
free square.
It resolves nothing on arrival.
Spend at the end of your turn — moved second only, one a game.

free square.

Spend at the end of your turn — moved second only, one a game.
Mirror
Swap what stands on one facing pair
through the centre: 0 and 8, 1 and
7, 2 and 6, 3 and 5.
Whoever owns the two stones.
Spend at the end of your turn — moved second only, one a game.
Mirror

through the centre: 0 and 8, 1 and
7, 2 and 6, 3 and 5.

Spend at the end of your turn — moved second only, one a game.
Mind Control
Name a stone in your opponent’s
hand. That is what they must play
next turn.
You never touch the stone yourself.
Spend at the end of your turn — moved second only, one a game.

Rehearse
Resolve one of your stones on the
board again, from wherever it now
stands.
Not one the space has switched off.
Spend at the end of your turn — moved second only, one a game.
